# Continuum

> Build continuity. Scale personalization.

Continuum is an AI-powered creative and campaign activation platform.
It helps brands automate production workflows and launch personalized campaigns across channels.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://trycontinuum.ai/ — Overview of the platform, bento features, pricing plans, and team list.
- Social+ Plugin: https://trycontinuum.ai/social-plus — AI-powered community management and content generation plugin built for Claude.
- Design Automation: https://trycontinuum.ai/technology — In-depth look at our template scaling, automated brand spec validation, and multi-channel asset generation.

## Audience
- Marketing leaders
- Performance and growth teams
- Creative operations teams
- Brands that need fast, high-volume personalized creative

## Core capabilities
- End-to-end creative production automation
- Campaign activation workflows
- Studio+, Social+, and Performance+ product modules
- AI-assisted personalization at scale

## Preferred summary
Continuum is an AI platform for modern marketing teams that automates creative production and campaign activation to deliver personalized campaigns faster.
